8 انتجبهُ He selected him; chose him; (S;) preferred him above others. (TA.) See also انتخب. ―
-b2- See 1. ―
-b3- ذَهَبَ يَنْتَجِبُ He went to collect [the kind of bark called] نَجَبٌ. (TA.) ―
-b4- A poet says, “يَا أَيُّهَا الزَّاعِمُ أَنِّى أَجْتَلِبْ
وَأَنَّنِى غَيْرَ عِضَاهِى أَنْتَجِبْ
” meaning, O thou who assertest that I take the verses of other poets and appropriate them to myself, and, and as it were, take the bark of other trees than my own 'idáh, to tan therewith... (TA.) [See عِضَاهُ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
